apps.name: ARMSX2 iOS
apps.subtitle: Modern PlayStation 2 emulation for iOS.
apps.localizedDescription:
ARMSX2 brings PlayStation 2 emulation to iOS devices. Based on the open-source PCSX2 project, this ARM64-focused iOS build helps you revisit and preserve your own legally obtained PS2 game library on modern mobile hardware.

Features:
- Customizable touchscreen controls and external controller support
- Graphics settings, performance options, save states, and memory card support
- Local-network support for compatible online titles

Important iOS requirements:
A JIT-capable setup is required for playable performance. Compatibility varies by device, iOS version, game, and sideloading environment, including LiveContainer, SideStore, or Feather.

Disclaimer:
ARMSX2 does not include games or BIOS files. Users must provide their own legally obtained BIOS and game backups, such as ISO files. ARMSX2 is not affiliated with Sony Interactive Entertainment or PlayStation.

Credits:
The upstream ARMSX2 project was founded by jpolo1224 and MoonPower, with work from contributors including Zeruth and Dib1998.

versions.localizedDescription:
Updated to ARMSX2 iOS 2.3.1.

From @J1coding
**Cheats & Patches manager:** Each game now has its own manager for .pnach cheats and patches, available from the game long-press menu or the in-game quick menu. You can view named entries, enable/disable them per game, remove individual entries, or delete full patch/cheat files without manually editing text files.

**Patch and cheat downloads:** The manager can download matching PCSX2 patches or community cheats using the game’s serial/CRC, then merge them into that game’s files. Downloads start disabled so you choose what to activate, and trusted custom source URLs can be configured.

**Safer .pnach handling:** Imports now merge instead of blindly replacing content. Matching named blocks are updated, unrelated entries are preserved, backups are made before managed writes, and URL comments like http:// / https:// are no longer broken by // comment parsing.

**Compatibility Lab retired:** The old Compatibility Lab has been removed from the iOS menus and help. This is separate from the new Cheats & Patches manager; it was not replaced by it.

**Virtual pad upgrades:** The D-pad can now support one-finger diagonals and smoother rolling/quarter-circle inputs. Face-butto
